reasoning_traces.think:
The core structure of Fantasy War Room emerges from three foundational principles: (1) a provider-agnostic interface that decouples decision-making from platform-specific APIs; (2) an evidence-based engine that mirrors the rigor of professional picks; and (3) a canonical entity graph that ensures data integrity across leagues and time. These form a dual system where GSI handles probabilistic inference and GSE manages contextual transitions. The failure mode arises when the entity schema is unapproved—blocking implementation entirely. This aligns with historical developments in agent-based systems where modularity and trust boundaries define operational limits. The theory of mind involves modeling both the user's intent and the evolving dynamics of player roles, injuries, and matchups. Anti-collinearity checks ensure that no two use cases produce redundant signals, maintaining signal-to-noise ratio in recommendations.
